prompts.su: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated transparent HEAD-ONLY 2D game sprite of Su Tseng-chang 蘇貞昌. Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE IDENTITY reference, an official portrait: preserve this man's actual facial structure and recognizability carefully. Image 2 is ONLY the ink/crosshatch/color style reference, NOT identity; do not borrow its hair, eyes or jaw. The old generic bald-man caricature was not recognizable enough, so prioritize faithful likeness with restrained editorial exaggeration. Su's essential features: high bald forehead with a modest rounded dome, very narrow dark-gray side-hair strips, fine almost rimless eyeglasses clearly visible across the nose, natural moderate straight-curved eyebrows, narrow cheerful eyes, pronounced cheekbones and deep curved smile folds, broad upper-teeth smile, tapered angular lower face rather than a spherical fat head. Draw warm peach skin matching image 2, black ink contour and fine hand crosshatching, editorial satirical cartoon, never photorealistic. Face turns only slightly toward screen RIGHT, about 15 degrees, keeping both eyes and the distinctive glasses legible. Complete scalp, ears and chin, no neck or clothing, no body, no background, no words. Square 1254x1254 composition with head filling about 92% and clear transparent margin. Do not enlarge forehead excessively, do not use villainous arched eyebrows, do not omit glasses. Actual transparent alpha.
